source: M2 relic mask (docs/rl_redesign.md): every relic in sts2.names()["relic"] classified from decomp/MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Relics/*.cs override hooks and crates/sts2sim/src/content/relics/*.rs. hooks = decomp override methods (IsAllowed/AfterCloned dropped).

classes.combat: has an effect inside a fight (incl. end-of-fight heals / max HP)
classes.macro_only: no effect inside a fight; the network should not see it
classes.potion_linked: combat relevance is through potions (slots, generation, potion-use effects); scenarios must carry potions
classes.card_linked: leaves specific cards / curses / enchantments / type-wide upgrades in the deck; scenarios must carry them
